entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal of the petition.

The contents of the memo of withdrawal is as under:
"Counsel for the petitioner submits as follows.
It is submitted that the present petition was filed for quashing of the FIR and complaint in Crime No.52/2023,
Now the Respondent No.1 filed the charge sheet.
Hence to file the fresh petition with new ground, the petitioner is withdrawing the petition, kindly permitted to withdraw the petition in the interest of justice and equity.
In view of the memo and supporting submission, the petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
Liberty is granted as sought for.

Sd/-
